entities.title: Browser game
entities.summary: Everything that runs in the player's browser.
entities.purpose: Wires the pure engine to the page: the scenes, the fixed-step frame loop at 60 steps a second, recording, input from keys, gamepads and touch, drawing, sound, the name form, this browser's own table, the public table's client, and online play in lockstep.
boundaries: The rules live in engine/; this folder decides nothing about the game.
The relay for online games and the multiplayer lobby are the games hub's; src/online.ts only connects to them.
src/name.ts is also the server's: the Worker imports it to clean submitted names.
